title: Structural properties of Białynicki-Birula decompositions
summary: We investigate several aspects of the Bialynicki-Birula decomposition of a smooth complete $\mathbb{G}_m$-variety with finite fixed locus. Our results include novel characterizations of when the Bialynicki-Birula decomposition is filterable or forms a stratification, showing that these properties are invariant under reversing the $\mathbb{G}_m$-action. We additionally classify the smooth projective toric varieties for which the Bialynicki-Birula decomposition either may or must be a stratification.
